clos.original_description: Understand core concepts, differences, and relationships among MLOps, DevOps, DataOps, and LLMOps (including RAG & Prompt Engineering basics); apply cloud architecture patterns for ML systems (ingestion, storage, deployment models) across major cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI).
